16.. FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 MID-YEAR FINANCIAL REPORT AND CONSIDER ADOPTION OF RESOLUTION NO. 20-018 TO AMEND THE FISCAL YEAR 2020-2021 BUDGET (CITY COUNCIL).  -  Action: adopted (Pass) Moved by Cedric Hicks CM Landers gave a brief staff report

Finance Director Tarik gave power point presentation on the mid-year financial report. 

ACM Raymond gave a power point presentation on the City's grant program

Hicks inquired about the façade grant program. Staff addressed his inquiry. 

Discussion ensued between the City Council regarding the various grant programs. 

LDH directed staff to bring a report identifying how many loans have been given, along with which loan recipient have received federal grants/loans. In addition, she inquired about how much is going to the consultant assisting with the loan program. 

MPT requested staff include in report Minority/Women businesses.  

Discussion ensued about the loan being a bridge program 

225K to continue the grant program for applications in the queue with no objections heard. 

Director Rahmani proceeded with powerpoint presentation.  

Director Jane spoke about Carson Event Center Construction. CM Landers directed Director Jane to bring back a report detailing the project and opportunity to fast track the completion date. 

City Council addressed their request for purchasing state of the art equipment  

361K for Carson Event Center with no objection heard. 

Discussion ensued about the Income Tax Preparation Filing Service. MPT directed staff to reach out to AARP for assistance. 30K with no objection heard. 

Discussion ensued about tree maintenance and removal and tree trimming. 

Directed staff to bring back a report for cost of a tree maintenance program and allocate 60K Tree Planting Project.

15.. CONSIDER INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE NO. 21-2102, AMENDING CHAPTER 6 (FLOODPLAIN MANAGEMENT) OF ARTICLE VII (BUILDING REGULATIONS- SEWAGE AND WASTE) OF THE CARSON MUNICIPAL CODE PURSUANT TO FEDERAL EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT AGENCY MANDATE (CITY COUNCIL)  -  Action: adopted (Pass) Moved by Jim Dear ACM Raymond gave brief staff report.

LDH spoke about the importance about

During discussion of the motion, CH brought up eCommerce

Hilton inquired if the body want to dissolve the UUT standing committee in light of a UUT sunset.

Hicks spoke about ensuring that the appointments be derivative of districts.   

Hilton inquired about Technology innovation and Human Relations. It was pleasure of the council to remove human relations from the eliminate list and reduce membership to 7 with 2 alternates.
